title: technology preset
description: What a dataset of one technology opens with in the viewer, before its owner's saved settings and before the link (docs/specs/ADR-technology-presets.md). Every field is optional; a field left out keeps the viewer's built-in default. A viewer ignores fields it does not know.

colormap.description: Colormap of gene expression and numerical columns.

hideZeroExpression.description: Cells with no count of the shown gene are not drawn.

cellOpacity.description: The cells' opacity as a whole.
